fact: NIRA says about 636,000 children have been enrolled and it has registration centres in most major hospitals where parents register newborns.

NIRA says the NIN is issued automatically once a birth notification is made and certification is immediate, with no biometrics needed for a child 9 months or under; deploying crvs.nsis.nira.go.ug for birth registration and instant NIN generation is still a next step.
